as_told.title: Charles Manson as an MK Ultra subject

plain: Michels says Charles Manson, the cult leader behind the 1969 Los Angeles murders, was a patient of MK Ultra, the CIA's secret mind-control research programme. He credits the idea to a friend in Los Angeles named Tom O'Neill, who he says "documents it pretty well," and names a man named Jolly West alongside it; on a later episode he repeats it, hedged as "probably," with no credit given. If true, it would tie one of America's most notorious crimes to a government programme.
